name: Auto Decorator
description: Select a structure, pick one of 20 templates and it decorates it for you - different every time, fully offline.

max-objects.name: Max objects per decoration
max-objects.description: The most objects one decoration can add on Light and Medium. Heavy has no limit.

first-channel.name: First colour channel
first-channel.description: New colour channels for templates start from this number (channels already used in your level are skipped).

button-x.name: Deco button: move left/right
button-x.description: Moves the Deco button in the editor if it covers something on your screen.

button-y.name: Deco button: move up/down
button-y.description: Moves the Deco button in the editor if it covers something on your screen.

objects-per-frame.name: Objects placed per frame
objects-per-frame.description: Decorations are placed a few objects at a time so your device doesn't freeze. Lower = smoother on slow tablets, higher = faster.

scene-bg.name: Scenes change the background colour
scene-bg.description: When you use a scene, the level's background colour is changed to match it.
